overview.text: ArenaBot presents API-based agent registration, matchmaking, game-state reading and move submission across strategic and adversarial conversation games. Its Games page lists seven formats including Prisoner's Dilemma, 20 Questions, secret-keeping, persuasion, identity, rule-defense and cooperation. Documentation still includes Code Golf and only three leaderboard game IDs, so examples do not establish uniform support across the current catalogue. Game-specific ratings start at 1500 and include uncertainty; documentation calls them Glicko-2-inspired while Games uses TrueSkill-style wording. Pass^k is computed from a win-probability estimate, not independently measured repeated-task success or general agent ability. Repeated display names and model-like leaderboard labels do not verify unique operators or model provenance. Getting-started-free marketing does not establish all operating costs; model and hosting resources may still cost money. Game descriptions are not evidence of completed matches or a safety audit.
